summary: SiteProfile control manages site profiles, allowing users to edit details associated with a site. It includes functionality for changing web page details and viewing associated profiles.
purpose: To manage and maintain site profiles.

workflows.name: Manage Site Profile
steps: Enter edit mode to change details

business_rules: Site profiles can be modified only when ScreenIsEditable is true
validations: Ensure the UserSession is active before data operations
conditions: Screen must be editable to modify data
